full_text_zh:
[P1] 小房子
HER
STORY
阿甲/译
〔美〕维吉尼亚·李·伯顿/文·图

[P2] 小房子

[美]维吉尼亚·李·伯顿◎著绘
艾柯◎译

天津出版传媒集团
百花文艺出版社

[P5] 很久以前，
在离城市很远的乡下，
有一座小房子。
这座小房子盖得真好！
又漂亮又结实。
盖这座房子的主人说：
“小房子永远不能卖，
给多少钱都不卖。她要看着
我们的孙子的孙子的孙子的
孙子的孙子的孙子住在里面。”

[P6] 小房子坐落在山冈上，
开心地看着身边的田园风光：
清晨，她看着太阳升起，
黄昏，她看着太阳落下。
一天又一天，
每天都有点儿不一样……
可小房子总是老样子。

[P7] SUN MON TUE WED THU FRI SAT

每天晚上，
她看着月亮慢慢变化，
从一弯新月变成一轮满月；
然后，又变回一弯清瘦的月亮。
没有月光的时候，
她就看星星，
还有远方城市里的灯光。
小房子对那里很好奇，
住在城里是什么样呢？

[P8] 时间从小房子
身边悄悄溜走，
她看着田园在季节的脚步中
变换模样。
春天来了，
白天日渐加长，
阳光暖和起来，
她等待着从南方飞回的
第一只知更鸟。
她看着草地慢慢变绿，
树枝上跳出嫩绿的新芽，
她看着苹果树在风中笑开了花，
孩子们在小溪里玩耍。

[P9] 长长的夏日，
她坐在阳光下，
看着层层叠叠的树木，
为自己披上绿衣裳。
她看着白色的雏菊铺满山冈。
花园里一片欣欣向荣。
她看着苹果熟得通红，
孩子们在池塘里游泳。

[P10] 到了秋天，
白天一天天缩短，
夜晚越来越冷，
她看着第一场霜降
浸染开一片又一片绿叶。
山间闪烁着黄色、橙色和红色的叶片。
她看着人们收割庄稼、
采摘苹果。
她看着孩子们
回到学校去读书。

[P11] 不知不觉冬天来了，
夜晚更长，白天更短，
白雪覆盖着乡村田园。
她看着孩子们
溜冰、滑雪橇。
一年又一年……
苹果树老了，
地里又种上了新树。
孩子们长大了，
离开这里去了城市。
现在，每到夜里，
城市的灯光好像
越发明亮、越发靠近了。

[P12] 一天，小房子
惊讶地看到，
弯弯曲曲的乡间小路上，
开来一辆不用马拉的车……
没多久，出现了更多这样的车，
用马拉的车越来越少了。
不久，一群测量员来了，
在小房子前面测量出一条路线。
接着，又来了一辆蒸汽挖土机，
在铺满雏菊的山冈上挖开一条路……
后来，一些卡车来了，在路上卸下大石头，
卸下小石头，
卸下沥青和沙子，
最后，来了一辆蒸汽压路机，
把一切都压平——
一条公路修好了。

[P13] 现在，小房子
看着各种各样的汽车
从城市那边开过来，又开过去。
加油站……
路边店……
各种各样的小房子
沿着公路两侧盖起来。
每个人、每样东西，
都移动得比以前快多了。

[P14] 公路越来越多，
把乡村田园分割成一块一块的。
房子越来越多，
盖得又高又大。
住宅区、公寓楼、
学校、商店、修车铺……
一个接一个出现在这片土地上，
堆挤在小房子周围。
已经没有人愿意住在小房子里，
也没有人再来照顾她。
小房子永远不能卖，
所以她只能待在那儿，看着。

[P15] 现在夜里不再安宁，
城市的灯光很亮、很近，
沿途的路灯彻夜通明。
“住在城里就是这样吧。”
小房子想，
她不知道自己喜不喜欢这样。
她怀念开满雏菊的山冈，
和月光下跳舞的苹果树。

[P16] 没过多久，
有轨电车
出现在小房子门前。
整个白天和大半个晚上，
它们都开来开去。
每个人看上去都很忙碌，
每个人看上去都行色匆匆。

[P17] 没过多久，
一辆高架列车
从小房子上面呼啸而过。
空气中到处是灰尘，
噪音也非常大，
震得小房子直抖。
现在她分不清几时是春天、几时是夏天。
秋天和冬天都去哪儿了？
一切看上去总是一个样。

[P18] 没过多久，
一辆地铁
从小房子下面呼啸而过。
她虽然看不到，
却能听到，也能感觉到。
人们移动得越来越快、越来越快，
没人会注意小房子。
他们匆匆而过，来不及看她一眼。

[P19] 没过多久，
人们拆掉小房子周围的
住宅区和公寓楼，
开始挖大坑……一边一个。
蒸汽挖土机在这边挖出三层楼的深坑，
在那边挖出四层楼的深坑。
上面建起了新的大楼——
这边二十五层，
那边三十五层。

[P20] 现在，
小房子只能在中午时见到太阳，
夜晚，
再也看不到星星和月亮，
因为城市的灯光实在太亮了。
她不喜欢住在城里。
经常梦见乡下，
那开满雏菊的山冈，
和月光下跳舞的苹果树。

小房子
很孤独、也很难过。
她外面的彩色漆裂开了，落满灰尘，
她的窗户坏了，百叶窗斜斜地挂着。
她看上去很破旧……虽然里面还像从前一样好。

[P21] 在一个晴朗的春日早晨，
那位建造了小房子的主人的
孙子的孙子的孙女来了。
她看到这破旧的小房子，并没有匆匆而过。
仿佛小房子有种不同寻常的东西让她停下脚步。
她对丈夫说：‘这个小房子像是我奶奶小时候住过的，
只是那个小房子在离城市很远的乡下，
一个铺满雏菊的山冈上，
周围长着苹果树。’

[P22] 最终他们发现，这就是那个小房子。
于是他们找到搬家公司，
问问小房子还能不能搬走。
搬家公司把小房子仔细检查了一遍，说：
“当然能。这房子和以前一样好。
她盖得很结实，我们可以把她搬到任何地方。”
于是，他们用起重机把小房子放到拖车上。
搬走她的时候交通停了几个小时，
她被慢慢拖着，离开了城市。

[P23] 一开始，小房子有点儿害怕。
可她习惯后，觉得挺好玩儿。
他们沿着大路向前滑，
他们沿着小路向前滑，
一直去到离城市很远的乡下。
当小房子看到绿草青青，
听到鸟儿鸣叫，她再也不难过了。
他们走啊走，可似乎就是找不到
特别合适的地方。
他们让小房子在这儿试试，
到那儿试试……
终于，他们看到一个小山冈，
正好在一片原野的中央，
周围长着苹果树。
“看那儿，”主人的孙子的孙子的孙女说，
“那个地方正合适。”
“是的，就是那儿。”小房子也对自己说。
他们在小山顶上挖了一个坑，
然后慢慢把小房子从路上移到山上。

[P24] 窗户和百叶窗修好了，
人们再一次给她涂上
漂亮的粉红色油漆。
当小房子在这片新地方
安顿下来时，
她高兴地笑了。
她又可以看见
太阳、月亮和星星。
她又可以看见
春天和夏天，
秋天和冬天，
轮回流转。

再一次，
有人住进了小房子，
又来照顾她了。

[P25] 她再也不会对城市好奇了，
也不想去那儿了。
天上的星星对她眨眼睛，
弯弯的月亮升上天空。
这里是春天——乡村处处平和、安宁。
full_text_en:
[P1] Little House
HER
STORY
Translated by A Jia
[USA] Virginia Lee Burton / Text & Illustrations

[P2] Little House

[USA] Virginia Lee Burton ◎ Author and Illustrator
Ai Ke ◎ Translator

Tianjin Publishing Media Group
Baihua Literature and Art Publishing House

[P5] Long ago,
far away from the city, in the countryside,
there was a little house.
This little house was built so well!
It was beautiful and sturdy.
The owner who built this house said:
"This little house can never be sold,
no matter how much money is offered. She wants to see
our grandson's grandson's grandson's
grandson's grandson's grandson living inside."

[P6] The little house sits on a hill,
cheerfully watching the countryside around her:
In the morning, she watches the sun rise,
in the evening, she watches the sun set.
Day after day,
every day is a little different...
but the little house always looks the same.

[P7] SUN MON TUE WED THU FRI SAT

Every evening,
She watches the moon slowly change,
From a crescent moon into a full moon;
Then, back into a slender crescent moon.
When there's no moonlight,
She looks at the stars,
And the lights of the distant city.
The little house is very curious about that place,
What is it like to live in the city?

[P8] Time slipped quietly by the little house,
She watched the countryside change with the seasons.
Spring came,
Days grew longer,
The sun grew warm,
She waited for the first robin returning from the south.
She watched the grass turn green slowly,
New green buds sprouted on the branches,
She watched the apple trees bloom in the wind,
Children played in the little stream.

[P9] Long summer days,
She sits in the sunlight,
Watching layers of trees,
Dressing herself in green.
She sees white daisies covering the hill.
The garden is full of vitality.
She sees apples ripening red,
Children swimming in the pond.

[P10] When autumn came,
the days grew shorter and shorter,
and the nights grew colder and colder.
She watched the first frost
paint one leaf after another.
In the hills, yellow, orange, and red leaves sparkled.
She watched people harvest crops,
pick apples.
She watched the children
return to school to study.

[P11] Unknowingly, winter has come,
Nights grow longer, days shorter,
Snow covers the countryside.
She watches the children
Skating, sledding.
Year after year...
The apple tree grows old,
New trees are planted in the fields.
The children grow up,
Leaving here for the city.
Now, every night,
The city lights seem
Brighter and closer than before.

[P12] One day, the little house
was surprised to see,
on the winding country road,
a car that didn't need horses to pull it...
Soon, more of these cars appeared,
and horse-drawn vehicles became fewer and fewer.
Not long after, a group of surveyors arrived,
measuring out a route in front of the little house.
Then, a steam excavator came,
digging a path through the daisy-covered hill...
Later, trucks arrived, unloading big rocks,
small rocks,
asphalt and sand.
Finally, a steam roller came,
pressing everything flat—
a road was built.

[P13] Now, the little house
watches all kinds of cars
come from the city and go back again.
Gas stations...
Roadside shops...
All kinds of little houses
are built along both sides of the road.
Everyone, everything,
moves much faster than before.

[P14] The roads kept multiplying,
breaking up the countryside into smaller and smaller pieces.
The houses kept multiplying,
getting taller and bigger.
Residential areas, apartment buildings,
schools, shops, repair shops...
one after another appeared on this land,
crowding around the little house.
No one wanted to live in the little house anymore,
and no one came to take care of her.
The little house could never be sold,
so she could only stay there, watching.

[P15] Now the nights were no longer peaceful.
City lights were bright and close,
and streetlights along the way shone all night long.
"This is what living in the city is like," thought the little house.
She didn't know if she liked it or not.
She missed the hillside covered with daisies,
and the apple trees dancing under the moonlight.

[P16] Not long after,
streetcars
appeared in front of the little house.
All day and most of the night,
they came and went.
Everyone looked very busy,
everyone looked hurried and rushed.

[P17] Not long after,
An elevated train
Rushed over the little house.
The air was full of dust,
The noise was very loud,
Shaking the little house.
Now she couldn't tell when it was spring or summer.
Where had autumn and winter gone?
Everything looked the same all the time.

[P18] Not long after,
A subway train
roared past beneath the little house.
She couldn't see it,
but she could hear it, and feel it.
People moved faster and faster,
no one noticed the little house.
They hurried by, not even glancing at her.

[P19] Not long after,
people tore down the residential areas and apartment buildings
around the little house,
beginning to dig huge pits—one on each side.
Steam excavators dug pits as deep as three stories here,
and four stories deep there.
On top, new skyscrapers rose—
twenty-five stories here,
thirty-five stories there.

[P20] Now,
the little house could only see the sun at noon,
and at night,
could no longer see the stars and the moon,
because the city lights were simply too bright.
She didn't like living in the city.
She often dreamed of the countryside,
that hillside covered with daisies,
and the apple tree dancing under the moonlight.

The little house
was very lonely and very sad.
Her colorful paint outside had cracked and was covered in dust,
her windows were broken, and her shutters hung crookedly.
She looked very old and worn... though inside, she was still as good as before.

[P21] On a bright spring morning,
the granddaughter of the grandson of the owner who built the little house arrived.
She saw the old, run-down house and did not pass by in a hurry.
It seemed as if the little house had something unusual that made her stop.
She said to her husband, 'This little house reminds me of the one my grandmother lived in when she was young,
only that one was far from the city, in the countryside,
on a hill covered with daisies,
with apple trees all around.'

[P22] In the end, they discovered that this was the little house.
So they found a moving company,
and asked if the little house could still be moved.
The moving company carefully inspected the house and said:
"Of course. The house is just as good as before.
It's built very solidly; we can move it anywhere."
Then, they used a crane to place the little house onto a trailer.
When they moved her, traffic stopped for several hours,
and she was slowly dragged away from the city.

[P23] At first, the little house was a bit afraid.
But after she got used to it, she found it quite fun.
They slid along the big road,
They slid along the little road,
All the way to the countryside far from the city.
When the little house saw the green grass,
And heard the birds singing, she was no longer sad.
They walked and walked, but seemed to find no
Particularly suitable place.
They let the little house try here,
And try there...
Finally, they saw a little hill,
Right in the middle of a meadow,
Surrounded by apple trees.
"Look there," said the granddaughter of the owner's grandson's grandson,
"That place is just right."
"Yes, that's it," the little house said to herself.
They dug a hole on top of the hill,
And slowly moved the little house from the road up onto the hill.

[P24] The windows and shutters were repaired,
and people painted her once again
with beautiful pink paint.
When the little house settled down in this new place,
she smiled happily.
She could see the sun, moon, and stars again.
She could see spring and summer,
autumn and winter,
rotating in cycles.

Once again,
someone moved into the little house,
and came to take care of her.

[P25] She would never be curious about the city again,
and she didn't want to go there.
The stars in the sky blinked at her,
and the crescent moon rose into the sky.
This is spring—the countryside is peaceful and tranquil everywhere.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《小房子》的封面，展示了书名、作者信息和插图，画面中央是一座小房子，周围环绕着花朵和树木，背景是蓝天和太阳。
[P2] 本页为绘本《小房子》的封面，展示了书名、作者、译者及出版社信息，画面中央是一座小房子，两侧有树木，背景简洁。
[P3] 本页通过三幅横向分层的画面，展示了小房子周围环境随时间推移的变化：从宁静的乡村生活，到出现马车和汽车的小镇，再到高楼林立、车水马龙的城市景象，暗示了城市化进程对小房子家园的影响。
[P4] 本页通过三幅横向分层的画面，展示了小房子周围环境随时间推移的变化：从宁静的乡村生活，到出现马车和汽车的小镇，再到高楼林立、车水马龙的城市景象，暗示了城市化进程对小房子家园的影响。
[P5] 本页讲述了很久以前，在远离城市的乡下，有一座漂亮结实的小房子，主人发誓永远不卖，希望子孙后代能一直住在这里。画面描绘了小房子坐落在绿草如茵的山坡上，周围有树木和一家人在散步，展现了宁静美好的乡村生活。
[P6] 本页描绘了小房子坐落在山冈上，每天看着太阳升起和落下，享受宁静的田园风光，虽然每天有些许变化，但小房子本身始终如一。
[P7] 本页描绘了小房子在夜晚观察月亮变化、星星和远方城市灯光的景象，表达了它对城市生活的好奇。
[P8] 本页描绘了小房子在春天里观察田园风光的变化，包括草地变绿、新芽萌发、苹果树开花和孩子们在溪边玩耍，展现了宁静美好的乡村生活。
[P9] 本页描绘了小房子在夏日里宁静祥和的田园生活，周围绿树成荫，花园繁茂，孩子们在池塘游泳，展现了乡村生活的美好与生机。
[P10] 本页描绘了秋天到来时，小房子周围的田园景象：树叶变色、人们收割庄稼和采摘苹果，孩子们回到学校读书，展现了宁静而富有生机的乡村秋日生活。
[P11] 本页描绘了冬天到来时，小房子周围的乡村被白雪覆盖，孩子们在雪地里溜冰、滑雪橇。随着时间推移，苹果树老去，孩子们长大后离开乡村去了城市，而城市的灯光在夜晚显得越来越明亮、越来越近。
[P12] 小房子目睹了乡村道路被现代化施工改造的过程：从出现不用马拉的车，到测量、挖掘、运输材料，最后用压路机修好一条公路。
[P13] 小房子目睹公路建成后，各种汽车往来穿梭，加油站、路边店和新房子陆续出现，乡村生活节奏明显加快。
[P14] 本页描绘了乡村被城市化快速改造的景象：公路和高楼不断增多，各种建筑和车辆挤满了小房子周围，小房子被遗忘在城市边缘，只能默默注视着这一切变化。
[P15] 小房子被城市包围，夜晚灯火通明，它感到不安并怀念过去的乡村生活。
[P16] 有轨电车出现在小房子门前，日夜穿梭，人们行色匆匆，乡村生活节奏加快，小房子被城市化的喧嚣包围。
[P17] 高架列车在小房子上方呼啸而过，带来灰尘和巨大噪音，小房子感到震动，它已分不清四季，周围环境变得单调而喧嚣。
[P18] 小房子被城市交通包围，地铁在它下方呼啸而过，人们行色匆匆，无人注意它，小房子感到被忽视和孤独。
[P19] 小房子周围的住宅区和公寓楼被拆除，人们开始挖掘深坑，用蒸汽挖土机施工，随后在坑上建造起高达二十五层和三十五层的新大楼，城市化建设迅速推进。
[P20] 小房子被高楼和城市交通包围，只能在中午见到太阳，夜晚被灯光遮蔽，无法看到星星和月亮。它感到孤独和难过，外表破旧，但内心仍怀念过去的乡村生活。
[P21] 在一个晴朗的春日早晨，建造小房子的主人的曾孙女来到城市，被这栋破旧的小房子吸引而停下脚步，她向丈夫回忆起奶奶小时候在乡下住过的相似房子，那里有雏菊和苹果树。
[P22] 小房子被发现后，搬家公司检查确认其完好无损，用起重机将其装上拖车，在交通暂停数小时后，小房子被缓缓拖离了城市。
[P23] 小房子被拖车运往乡下，在途中逐渐适应并感到快乐。一行人最终在一片原野中央的小山冈上找到合适地点，那里有苹果树，小房子也认同这是理想的新家，人们开始挖坑准备安放它。
[P24] 小房子被修缮并安放在乡下的新家，重新见到自然的四季和星空，有人再次住进并照顾她，恢复了往日的幸福生活。
[P25] 小房子在乡下的新家安顿下来，夜晚星空下，它不再向往城市，享受着乡村的平和与安宁。
